about_the_game:
"Ever feel like you're cut off from the world in an elevator?

...What if the doors opened, and it was a different world entirely?"

About This Game:

Shadow Dwellers: Deliverance is a 3D first-person game that fuses psychological horror with the walking simulator genre. You play as a rookie delivery person assigned to bring packages to the infamous Kagesumi Apartments, a building plagued by bizarre rumors.

Your task is simple: deliver the package to the room number written on the slip. But sometimes, the elevator doesn’t take you where you intend—it connects to an Otherworld.

In that place, the laws of reality bend in subtle ways. What should be there is missing. Something unseen is always moving forward.

There is only one way to escape: find the Resonant Bell—and ring it.

Once you return, continue your delivery as if nothing happened.

But what if your destination is on a floor that doesn’t exist?

Estimated Playtime

30 - 60 minutes

Features

  • [OBSERVE] A Warped Everyday Life, A Connected Otherworld:

    Your mission is interrupted by the countless "Otherworlds" you stumble into through the elevator. Lights vanish. Impossible figures linger. Familiar corridors twist into alien realms. The longer you remain, the more your sanity erodes. Yet to escape, you must observe carefully and search for the Resonant Bell.

  • [DECIPHER] Gazing Into the Depths with the "Otherworld Connection":

    As deliveries continue, you’ll eventually be required to reach non-existent floors. By piecing together cryptic clues hidden throughout the apartments, you can learn to open the gateway to the Otherworlds yourself. It is a dangerous choice—but the only path toward the truth.

  • [DELIVER] Unnerving Packages and Mysterious "Residents":

    Delivery slips list unsettling cargo and vague instructions. With each package, you’ll realize the items themselves are tied to the heart of the anomaly. And in the corners of the corridors stand beings that aren’t quite human. Who are they, and what do they want?

  • [DEVIATE] Observation and Defiance Forge a New Ending:

    Merely obeying instructions will never reveal the apartment’s true nature. But if you dare to observe deeply and deviate from the rules, you may unlock another ending. Will the chain of strange deliveries ever come to an end?

Will you finish this absurd delivery to the very end?

Or will you resist the hopeless fate woven into the building—

and seize your own Deliverance?

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: A first-person psychological horror. Explore a building via an elevator to uncanny "Otherworlds." With no combat, observation is your only tool. Uncover a hidden ritual using the elevator buttons to reach impossible floors. Break the rules to find the true ending in this multi-ending adventure.
